title: South Florida Weekend Nightlife Guide, Free And Cheap First
igCaption:
Cold front weekend, cheap plans first.

Sources: Secret Miami, WSVN 7News, Eventbrite, Miami New Times

#SouthFlorida #Broward #WeekendGuide #Nightlife

scenes.text: South Florida gets its coolest weekend since March, so this nightlife guide starts with free and cheap plans.
Start with the free stuff in Fort Lauderdale. Eventbrite has a current page for fun free things to do there, and Friday night dips to around 59 degrees.
scenes.caption: Start with the free stuff in Fort Lauderdale. Eventbrite has a current page for fun free things to do there, and Friday night dips to around 59 degrees.

scenes.text: Next is Motek By The Sea at W Fort Lauderdale. The new oceanfront location has a $5 happy hour, about 12,000 square feet, and room for 315 diners.
scenes.caption: Next is Motek By The Sea at W Fort Lauderdale. The new oceanfront location has a $5 happy hour, about 12,000 square feet, and room for 315 diners.

scenes.text: For Wilton Manors, Eventbrite has current pages for Hideaway on 26, soca parties, and whiskey festival activities. Saturday looks sunny with a high near 73. If you end up at Hideaway on 26, check NEAR for familiar faces.

scenes.text: If you want an indoor night, check the Seminole Hard Rock in Hollywood. Eventbrite has a current page for Hard Rock casino parties, and Sunday stays near 77.
